name: Rapid Multimodal Logistics Ltd
about: Incorporated in July 2020, Rapid Multimodal Logistics Limited is a Chennai-based company offering comprehensive logistical solutions to its clients.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] The company provides single and multimodal transportation services, integrating road, rail, and sea within a single supply chain to enhance efficiency and meeting shipment needs. Their services include planning, route optimization, carrier selection, documentation, containerization, tracking, communication, last-mile delivery, and performance evaluation.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 40.4%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
